entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant, who is in custody since 03.06.2023, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with POCSO Case No.61 of 2023, arising out of Dhurki P.S. Case No.18 of 2023,
registered for the offence under Sections 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5(1)(6) of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Spl. Judge, POCSO Act, Garhwa.

3. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
4. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the victim is just below the age of 18 years.
Both parties have solemnized marriage and she is residing with the applicant.

The applicant Vijay Choudhary vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65572259/
1 has given statement that the case has been lodged by the father of the victim against her wish.

entities.text: Vijay Choudhary vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She wants to lead matrimonial life with the applicant.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. From perusal of the record, it appears that out of seven charge-sheeted witnesses, two have already been examined.
7. Considering the statement of the girl, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly,
the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Spl. Judge, POCSO Act, Garhwa in connection with POCSO Case No.61 of 2023, arising out of Dhurki P.S. Case No.18 of 2023, subject to condition that the applicant(s) will submit self-attested photocopy/photocopies of his/her/their Aadhaar Card(s) and also submit his/her/their mobile number(s) before the learned court below which he/she/they will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Raja/-Uploaded Vijay Choudhary vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65572259/
